course_name_original: Applied Integrated Iron and Steel Production Process
course_name_en: Applied Integrated Iron and Steel Production Process

learning_outcomes.text: Knows the application process of integrated iron and steel process.
Knows raw material sources and usage areas and their effect on quality.
Knows the sinter process and its necessity.
Knows what coking is and its process.
Knows the methods of obtaining liquid raw iron, slag and recycling methods.
Knows steel production process and quality.
Knows what affects the quality of steel.
Knows the types of rolling and rolling products.
Knows alternative energy sources and environmental measures taken.
Knows what, how much and how to produce in the production process and how planning is done.

syllabus_topics: Production Planning, Raw material preparation process
Knowledge of the purposes of material formed by rolling and forging, knowledge of changes in its structure, requirements in areas of use and knowledge of surface steel grades.
Energy Management in an Integrated Iron and Steel Plant
